# mtncloud_mos_object (Resource)

A file (object) in a MOS bucket, up to 512 MiB. Changing its content uploads it again. MOS doesn't keep the content type an upload sets: every object is served as `binary/octet-stream`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_object" "index" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  key    = "index.html"
  source = "${path.module}/site/index.html" # editing the file uploads it again
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_object" "config" {
  bucket   = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  key      = "config.json"
  content  = jsonencode({ env = "prod" })
  metadata = { owner = "web-team" }
}

# Kept from deletion until the date (the bucket needs object_lock_enabled).
resource "mtncloud_mos_object" "report" {
  bucket         = "acme-records"
  key            = "reports/2026.pdf"
  source         = "${path.module}/reports/2026.pdf"
  retention_mode = "GOVERNANCE"
  retain_until   = "2027-12-31T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name.
- `key` (String) The object's name in the bucket, for example `site/index.html`. Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `bypass_governance_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the object on destroy, and shorten its retention, even while GOVERNANCE retention holds it. Needs permission to bypass it.
- `checksum_algorithm` (String) Have MOS check the upload with this checksum: `CRC32`, `CRC32C`, `SHA1` or `SHA256`. Needs checksums to be enabled on MTN Object Storage; the upload fails with a clear message when they aren't.
- `content` (String) The content, as text. Set one of `content`, `content_base64` and `source`.
- `content_base64` (String) The content, base64-encoded, for binary data.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Your own metadata, stored with the object as user metadata. Names are lower case.
- `retain_until` (String) The date and time the retention ends, in RFC 3339 (`2027-01-31T00:00:00Z`). Moving it later is always allowed; moving it earlier needs `bypass_governance_on_destroy = true`.
- `retention_mode` (String) Keep the object from deletion until `retain_until`: `GOVERNANCE`. The bucket must have object lock on.
- `source` (String) A local file to upload. Its content is compared at every plan, so editing the file uploads it again.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) The object's ETag: the MD5 of its content for an object uploaded in one part.
- `id` (String) `<bucket>/<key>`.
- `last_modified` (String) When the object was last written (RFC 3339).
- `size` (Number) The object's size in bytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_object.index acme-website/index.html
```
